examples.text_en: Her spontaneous laugh made the whole room happy.
examples.text_zh: 她自然的笑声让整个房间都愉快起来。

examples.text_en: It was a spontaneous act of simple kindness.
examples.text_zh: 那是一个自发的简单善举。

examples.text_en: The children began to sing spontaneously in the car.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们在车里自发地唱起歌来。

examples.text_en: The crowd stood up and clapped spontaneously.
examples.text_zh: 人群站起来，自发地鼓起掌来。

examples.text_en: The whole show was a funny spoof of old films.
examples.text_zh: 整场演出是对老电影的滑稽讽刺。

examples.text_en: They made a short spoof about the city news.
examples.text_zh: 他们拍了一个关于本市新闻的短小讽刺剧。

examples.text_en: She put the white thread on a small spool.
examples.text_zh: 她把白线缠在一个小线轴上。

examples.text_en: The spool fell and rolled across the floor.
examples.text_zh: 线轴掉下来，滚过了地板。

examples.text_en: He put a spoonful of sugar in his tea.
examples.text_zh: 他在茶里放了一匙糖。

examples.text_en: One spoonful of this will be more than enough.
examples.text_zh: 这个放一匙就足够了。

examples.text_en: The hunter followed the spoor of the great animal.
examples.text_zh: 猎人追踪那只大动物的足迹。

examples.text_en: Fresh spoor showed that the animal was near.
examples.text_zh: 新鲜的足迹表明那只动物就在附近。

examples.text_en: The rain was sporadic and did not last long.
examples.text_zh: 雨下得断断续续，没有持续多久。

examples.text_en: He made sporadic calls to his old friends.
examples.text_zh: 他偶尔给老朋友打打电话。

examples.text_en: She bought new sportswear for the long race.
examples.text_zh: 她为长跑买了新的运动装。

examples.text_en: This shop sells sportswear for the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 这家店卖全家人穿的运动装。

examples.text_en: The kitchen was spotless after a long day.
examples.text_zh: 忙了一整天后，厨房一尘不染。

examples.text_en: He kept his old car spotless and clean.
examples.text_zh: 他把旧车保持得干干净净。

examples.text_en: The spotlight followed her across the whole stage.
examples.text_zh: 聚光灯跟着她走遍整个舞台。

examples.text_en: He stood in the bright spotlight and spoke.
examples.text_zh: 他站在明亮的聚光灯下发言。

examples.text_en: Water came out of the spout in a thin stream.
examples.text_zh: 水从喷口里细细地流出来。

examples.text_en: The old spout was broken and would not work.
examples.text_zh: 旧喷口坏了，不出水了。

examples.text_en: The sprawling city grew far into the wide land.
examples.text_zh: 这座蔓延的城市一直扩展到广阔的土地上。

examples.text_en: They walked through the sprawling old market place.
examples.text_zh: 他们穿过那片不规则伸展的旧市场。

examples.text_en: The sprightly old man walked faster than us.
examples.text_zh: 这位活泼的老人走得比我们还快。

examples.text_en: She gave a sprightly song at the family party.
examples.text_zh: 她在家庭聚会上唱了一首轻快的歌。

examples.text_en: The pool has a high springboard for good divers.
examples.text_zh: 游泳池有一个供好跳水者用的高跳板。

examples.text_en: This job was a springboard to a fine career.
examples.text_zh: 这份工作是通向美好职业的跳板。

examples.text_en: They filled their bottles with cold springwater.
examples.text_zh: 他们把瓶子装满了冰凉的泉水。

examples.text_en: The springwater here is clean and good to drink.
examples.text_zh: 这里的泉水干净，很好喝。

examples.text_en: The small boy showed real spunk in the game.
examples.text_zh: 这个小男孩在比赛中表现出真正的勇气。

examples.text_en: It took spunk to say no to the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 敢于对整个队伍说不，需要勇气。

examples.text_en: The paper was full of spurious facts and names.
examples.text_zh: 那份文件满是伪造的事实和名字。

examples.text_en: He was paid with spurious money from a shop.
examples.text_zh: 他收到的是一家商店给的假钱。

examples.text_en: She chose to spurn his offer of help.
examples.text_zh: 她选择拒绝他的帮助。

examples.text_en: They spurn every idea that is not their own.
examples.text_zh: 他们排斥一切不是自己想出来的主意。

examples.text_en: A spurt of water came from the old pipe.
examples.text_zh: 一股水从旧管子里喷了出来。

examples.text_en: He made a final spurt and won the race.
examples.text_zh: 他最后冲刺，赢下了比赛。

examples.text_en: The children began to squabble about the last cake.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们为最后一块蛋糕争吵起来。

examples.text_en: A small squabble broke out over the new rules.
examples.text_zh: 大家为新的规定起了点小口角。

examples.text_en: A squad of police came to the old street.
examples.text_zh: 一小队警察来到这条老街。

examples.text_en: The whole squad ran onto the field together.
examples.text_zh: 整个小队一起跑上了场地。

examples.text_en: They lived in a squalid room with no windows.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在一间没有窗户的肮脏屋子里。

examples.text_en: The squalid street was dirty and full of fear.
examples.text_zh: 这条肮脏的街道又脏又让人害怕。

examples.text_en: A sudden squall turned the small boat around.
examples.text_zh: 一阵突如其来的飑把小船吹得转了向。

examples.text_en: The squall brought cold rain and strong wind.
examples.text_zh: 这场飑夹着冷雨和强风。

examples.text_en: The family was forced to live in squalor.
examples.text_zh: 这家人被迫生活在肮脏贫困之中。

examples.text_en: He wrote about the squalor of the poor city.
examples.text_zh: 他描写了这座贫穷城市的肮脏。

examples.text_en: Do not squander your money on useless things.
examples.text_zh: 不要把钱浪费在无用的东西上。

examples.text_en: He managed to squander his whole small fortune.
examples.text_zh: 他把小小的一笔家产挥霍一空。

examples.text_en: The blame falls squarely on the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 责任完全落在整个团队身上。

examples.text_en: He looked squarely at me and told the truth.
examples.text_zh: 他直视着我，说出了实话。

examples.text_en: He had to squat down to reach the low box.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不蹲下来够那个低矮的箱子。

examples.text_en: They squatted around the fire and told stories.
examples.text_zh: 他们围着火蹲坐下来讲故事。

examples.text_en: A small squeak came from behind the old door.
examples.text_zh: 门后传来一声小小的吱吱声。

examples.text_en: The mouse gave a faint squeak and ran away.
examples.text_zh: 老鼠轻轻吱了一声就跑开了。

examples.text_en: She is squeamish about blood and small wounds.
examples.text_zh: 她对血和小伤口很敏感。

examples.text_en: He felt squeamish at the sight of the food.
examples.text_zh: 看到那食物他觉得恶心。

examples.text_en: His feet made a soft squelch in the wet mud.
examples.text_zh: 他的脚在湿泥里发出轻轻的嘎吱声。

examples.text_en: A loud squelch came from the wet ground.
examples.text_zh: 湿地上传来响亮的嘎吱声。

examples.text_en: He had to squint to read the small words.
examples.text_zh: 他得眯着眼才能看清那些小字。

examples.text_en: She gave the paper a quick squint and smiled.
examples.text_zh: 她迅速瞥了一眼那张纸，笑了。

examples.text_en: He used a small toy to squirt water at us.
examples.text_zh: 他用一个小玩具朝我们喷水。

examples.text_en: Water began to squirt from the broken pipe.
examples.text_zh: 水开始从破裂的管子里喷出来。

examples.text_en: The old bridge has great strength and stability.
examples.text_zh: 这座老桥极为坚固稳定。

examples.text_en: They worked for the stability of the whole country.
examples.text_zh: 他们为整个国家的稳定而努力。

examples.text_en: The doctor tried to stabilize his weak heart.
examples.text_zh: 医生努力稳定他虚弱的心脏。

examples.text_en: They put up walls to stabilize the old house.
examples.text_zh: 他们砌起墙来加固那座老房子。

examples.text_en: Her staccato words came out fast and sharp.
examples.text_zh: 她断续的话语说得又快又尖利。

examples.text_en: The music had a strange staccato beat.
examples.text_zh: 这段音乐有一种奇怪的断奏节拍。

examples.text_en: The old stagecoach carried people across the land.
examples.text_zh: 旧时的公共马车载着人们穿越这片土地。

examples.text_en: They traveled by stagecoach in those early days.
examples.text_zh: 在那些早年的日子里，他们乘公共马车旅行。

examples.text_en: He began to stagger after the long hard walk.
examples.text_zh: 走了那么久那么累，他开始脚步蹒跚。

examples.text_en: The news made her stagger back in surprise.
examples.text_zh: 这消息让她惊得踉跄后退。

examples.text_en: The cost of the new building was staggering.
examples.text_zh: 新楼的造价高得惊人。

examples.text_en: He fell with a staggering step and hurt his hand.
examples.text_zh: 他脚步蹒跚地一跤摔倒，伤了手。

examples.text_en: The water in the old pool was stagnant and dark.
examples.text_zh: 旧水池里的水停滞不动，颜色发暗。

examples.text_en: Business was stagnant for most of that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年大部分时间生意都很萧条。

examples.text_en: Her voice sounded stagy and not at all natural.
examples.text_zh: 她的嗓音听起来很做作，一点也不自然。

examples.text_en: The whole show was stagy and rather too loud.
examples.text_zh: 整场表演都做作，而且太吵。

examples.text_en: The staid old man never said a wild word.
examples.text_zh: 那位沉着的老人从不说轻狂的话。

examples.text_en: They lived a staid and quiet life in town.
examples.text_zh: 他们在镇上过着沉着安静的生活。

examples.text_en: The kitchen has a stainless steel table and sink.
examples.text_zh: 厨房里有一张不锈钢桌子和水槽。

examples.text_en: This stainless steel will not change with time.
examples.text_zh: 这种不锈钢不会随时间而变化。

examples.text_en: She sat on the top stair and waited for me.
examples.text_zh: 她坐在最上面一级楼梯上等我。

examples.text_en: The old stair made a noise under his feet.
examples.text_zh: 旧楼梯在他脚下发出声响。

examples.text_en: The long game ended in a complete stalemate.
examples.text_zh: 这场漫长的比赛以完全的僵局告终。

examples.text_en: Both sides were caught in a hard stalemate.
examples.text_zh: 双方陷入了难解的僵局。

examples.text_en: He kept a small stall at the city market.
examples.text_zh: 他在市集上摆了一个小货摊。

examples.text_en: Do not stall and give me a clear answer.
examples.text_zh: 别拖延，给我一个明确的答复。

examples.text_en: The stalwart young man carried the heavy box.
examples.text_zh: 这位健壮的年轻人扛起了沉重的箱子。

examples.text_en: She was a stalwart friend in hard times.
examples.text_zh: 在艰难的时候她是个坚定的朋友。

examples.text_en: The long race took great strength and stamina.
examples.text_zh: 这场长跑需要极大的力气和耐力。

examples.text_en: He has the stamina to work all day.
examples.text_zh: 他有整天工作的耐力。

examples.text_en: He began to stammer when the teacher asked him.
examples.text_zh: 老师问他时，他开始结巴起来。

examples.text_en: She would stammer a little when she felt shy.
examples.text_zh: 她害羞时会有点口吃。

examples.text_en: He took a firm stance on the whole issue.
examples.text_zh: 他在整个问题上立场坚定。

examples.text_en: Her stance showed that she was ready to fight.
examples.text_zh: 她的姿势表明她准备好动手了。

examples.text_en: They used cloth to stanch the flow of blood.
examples.text_zh: 他们用布止住血流。

examples.text_en: Quick help can stanch the wound in minutes.
examples.text_zh: 及时的救助几分钟内就能给伤口止血。

examples.text_en: The company will standardize its forms next year.
examples.text_zh: 公司明年将把表格标准化。

examples.text_en: They want to standardize the tests in all schools.
examples.text_zh: 他们想让所有学校的考试标准化。

examples.text_en: All the schools use the same standardized test.
examples.text_zh: 所有学校都使用同一套标准化考试。

examples.text_en: They built standardized houses for the new town.
examples.text_zh: 他们为新城建造了标准化的房屋。

examples.text_en: The whole city came to a complete standstill.
examples.text_zh: 整座城市完全停顿下来。

examples.text_en: Work was at a standstill after the heavy snow.
examples.text_zh: 大雪之后，工作陷入了停顿。

examples.text_en: Our team won the second stanza of the long game.
examples.text_zh: 我们队赢下了这场漫长比赛的第二节。

examples.text_en: The third stanza of the game began after a break.
examples.text_zh: 短暂休息后，比赛的第三节开始了。

examples.text_en: Rice is a staple food in many warm countries.
examples.text_zh: 大米是许多温暖国家的主要食物。

examples.text_en: He used a staple to hold the pages together.
examples.text_zh: 他用一枚订书钉把纸页钉在一起。

examples.text_en: The star-crossed lovers could never be together.
examples.text_zh: 这对时运不济的恋人永远无法在一起。

examples.text_en: It was a star-crossed plan from the very start.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划从一开始就运气不好。

examples.text_en: Potatoes are full of starch and give us energy.
examples.text_zh: 土豆富含淀粉，能给我们能量。

examples.text_en: She put starch in the water before the wash.
examples.text_zh: 洗衣前她在水里加了浆糊。

examples.text_en: He stayed away from starchy food at night.
examples.text_zh: 他晚上不吃含淀粉的食物。

examples.text_en: Her starchy manner made everyone feel a little cold.
examples.text_zh: 她古板的举止让大家感到有些冷淡。

examples.text_en: The young singer rose to stardom very quickly.
examples.text_zh: 这位年轻歌手很快成了明星。

examples.text_en: Stardom changed his life in many strange ways.
examples.text_zh: 明星身份以许多奇怪的方式改变了他的生活。

examples.text_en: A red starfish lay on the wet white sand.
examples.text_zh: 一只红色海星躺在潮湿的白沙上。

examples.text_en: The children found a starfish near the cold rocks.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们在冰冷的岩石旁找到一只海星。

examples.text_en: The soup was a fine starter for the long meal.
examples.text_zh: 这道汤是这顿长餐的良好开端。

examples.text_en: The starter would not work on that cold morning.
examples.text_zh: 那个寒冷的早晨，起动机不工作了。

examples.text_en: He had to stash the money under the floor.
examples.text_zh: 他必须把钱藏在地板下面。

examples.text_en: She would stash old letters in a small box.
examples.text_zh: 她总是把旧信藏在一个小盒子里。

examples.text_en: The town was in a long stasis after the war.
examples.text_zh: 战后这座小镇长期停滞。

examples.text_en: Their talk reached a stasis and went no further.
examples.text_zh: 他们的谈话陷入停滞，再没有进展。

examples.text_en: The stately old building stood by the wide river.
examples.text_zh: 那座宏伟的古老建筑矗立在宽阔的河畔。

examples.text_en: They walked at a stately pace into the great hall.
examples.text_zh: 他们以庄重的步伐走进大厅。

examples.text_en: There was static on the phone line all night.
examples.text_zh: 电话线里整晚都有静电干扰。

examples.text_en: Static made the old radio hard to hear.
examples.text_zh: 静电让旧收音机很难听清。

examples.text_en: The car stayed stationary for a long time.
examples.text_zh: 那辆车长时间停着不动。

examples.text_en: Please keep the box stationary while I work.
examples.text_zh: 我工作的时候请让箱子保持静止。

examples.text_en: The report was full of statistical facts and numbers.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告满是统计数据和数字。

examples.text_en: They used statistical methods to study the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 他们用统计方法研究整个群体。

examples.text_en: The old hall was full of fine white statuary.
examples.text_zh: 古老的大厅里满是精美的白色雕像。

examples.text_en: They studied the statuary of that early time.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究那个早期的雕像艺术。

examples.text_en: He was a man of great stature and strength.
examples.text_zh: 他身材高大，力气也大。

examples.text_en: Her work gave her stature in the whole city.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作在整座城市里给了她声望。

examples.text_en: The new statute will take effect next month.
examples.text_zh: 这项新法规将于下月生效。

examples.text_en: They read the old statute out loud in court.
examples.text_zh: 他们在法庭上大声朗读了那项旧法规。

examples.text_en: There is a statutory limit on the whole period.
examples.text_zh: 整个期限有法定的限制。

examples.text_en: The workers have statutory rights to fair pay.
examples.text_zh: 工人享有获得公平报酬的法定权利。

examples.text_en: She was steadfast in her support for the plan.
examples.text_zh: 她坚定不移地支持这个计划。

examples.text_en: His steadfast love never left her side.
examples.text_zh: 他坚定的爱从未离开她身边。

examples.text_en: The cat moved with great stealth toward the bird.
examples.text_zh: 猫悄悄地向那只鸟靠近。

examples.text_en: They took the city by stealth at night.
examples.text_zh: 他们趁夜色秘密攻下了这座城市。

examples.text_en: The old steamer carried goods up the long river.
examples.text_zh: 那艘旧汽船沿着长河运送货物。

examples.text_en: They watched the steamer leave the small port.
examples.text_zh: 他们看着汽船离开小港口。

examples.text_en: A tall steeple rose above the small church.
examples.text_zh: 一座高高的尖顶耸立在小教堂上方。

examples.text_en: From the steeple we saw the whole green valley.
examples.text_zh: 从尖塔上我们看见了整个绿色的山谷。

examples.text_en: He had to steer the boat between the rocks.
examples.text_zh: 他得驾船从岩石之间穿过。

examples.text_en: She tried to steer the talk to a happy subject.
examples.text_zh: 她试着把谈话引向快乐的话题。

examples.text_en: The stellar light filled the cold night sky.
examples.text_zh: 星光充满了寒冷的夜空。

examples.text_en: She gave a stellar performance at the city hall.
examples.text_zh: 她在市政厅献上了一场出色的演出。

examples.text_en: The stench from the old fish was very strong.
examples.text_zh: 那旧鱼散发的恶臭非常浓烈。

examples.text_en: A bad stench filled the whole small room.
examples.text_zh: 一股恶臭充满了整个小房间。

examples.text_en: He used a stencil to paint the wall sign.
examples.text_zh: 他用模版在墙上刷出标记。

examples.text_en: The old stencil was made of thin metal.
examples.text_zh: 旧模版是用薄金属做的。

examples.text_en: His stentorian voice could be heard far away.
examples.text_zh: 他洪亮的声音在很远的地方都能听到。

examples.text_en: The stentorian call stopped every worker in the field.
examples.text_zh: 那洪亮的一声喊叫让田里每个工人都停了下来。

examples.text_en: They made a stereophotograph of the old building.
examples.text_zh: 他们给那座古老建筑拍了一张立体照片。

examples.text_en: A stereophotograph shows a scene in three dimensions.
examples.text_zh: 立体照片能呈现有立体感的场景。

examples.text_en: The dry land was sterile and could grow nothing.
examples.text_zh: 这片干旱的土地贫瘠，什么也长不出来。

examples.text_en: The doctor used a sterile tool for the work.
examples.text_zh: 医生用了无菌的工具来做这件事。

examples.text_en: He paid in sterling for the old book.
examples.text_zh: 他用英国货币买下了那本旧书。

examples.text_en: Her work is of sterling quality and value.
examples.text_zh: 她的作品品质纯正，很有价值。

examples.text_en: The doctor put a stethoscope on his chest.
examples.text_zh: 医生把听诊器放在他胸口。

examples.text_en: A stethoscope helps you hear the heart clearly.
examples.text_zh: 听诊器能帮你清楚地听到心跳。

examples.text_en: The steward brought us water on the long flight.
examples.text_zh: 乘务员在长途航班上给我们送来了水。

examples.text_en: He worked as a steward in a fine old house.
examples.text_zh: 他在一座精美的老宅里做管家。

examples.text_en: He wore a gold stickpin on his dark coat.
examples.text_zh: 他在深色外套上别着一枚金色领带夹。

examples.text_en: The stickpin fell off and was lost for days.
examples.text_zh: 领带夹掉了，好几天都没找到。

examples.text_en: The ground was sticky after the heavy rain.
examples.text_zh: 大雨过后地面黏糊糊的。

examples.text_en: His hands were sticky with sweet fruit juice.
examples.text_zh: 他的手被甜果汁弄得黏糊糊的。

examples.text_en: The cold wind made the wet cloth stiffen.
examples.text_zh: 冷风把湿布吹得发硬。

examples.text_en: He felt his whole body stiffen with fear.
examples.text_zh: 他感到全身因恐惧而僵住。

examples.text_en: There was a strange stiffness in his left arm.
examples.text_zh: 他的左臂有一种奇怪的僵硬。

examples.text_en: The stiffness of the old cloth was easy to feel.
examples.text_zh: 旧布的僵硬很容易摸出来。

examples.text_en: The thick smoke began to stifle everyone inside.
examples.text_zh: 浓烟开始让里面的人窒息。

examples.text_en: She tried to stifle a laugh during the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 会议期间她努力忍住笑意。

examples.text_en: There is still a stigma around this old illness.
examples.text_zh: 这种旧病至今仍带有污名。

examples.text_en: He felt the stigma of his early mistakes.
examples.text_zh: 他为早年的错误感到耻辱。

examples.text_en: People should not stigmatize those who need help.
examples.text_zh: 人们不应诬蔑那些需要帮助的人。

examples.text_en: The old rules would stigmatize the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 旧规矩会给全家人打上烙印。

examples.text_en: The stillness of the night made him feel calm.
examples.text_zh: 夜晚的沉静让他感到平静。

examples.text_en: A deep stillness fell over the whole valley.
examples.text_zh: 整个山谷陷入一片深深的寂静。

examples.text_en: He walked on stilts above the wet ground.
examples.text_zh: 他踩着高跷走在湿地上。

examples.text_en: The old house stood on stilts near the water.
examples.text_zh: 这座老房子用支柱架在水边。

examples.text_en: His stilted words made the whole talk feel strange.
examples.text_zh: 他生硬的话语让整场谈话显得古怪。

examples.text_en: The letter was stilted and hard to read.
examples.text_zh: 这封信很做作，读起来很费劲。

examples.text_en: The news was a stimulant to the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 这个消息对整个团队是一种激励。

examples.text_en: The new hope acted as a stimulant on everyone.
examples.text_zh: 新的希望激励了每一个人。

examples.text_en: The children reacted to many bright stimuli in class.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们在课堂上对许多明亮的刺激作出反应。

examples.text_en: New stimuli can help the old mind stay active.
examples.text_zh: 新的刺激能帮助老人保持头脑活跃。

examples.text_en: The new law was a stimulus to the whole market.
examples.text_zh: 新法律是对整个市场的一种刺激。

examples.text_en: Light is a common stimulus for small plants.
examples.text_zh: 光是幼苗常见的刺激因素。

examples.text_en: His stinginess made him lose all his old friends.
examples.text_zh: 他的吝啬让他失去了所有的老朋友。

examples.text_en: The stinginess of the whole group was surprising.
examples.text_zh: 整个群体的吝啬令人惊讶。

examples.text_en: He did a short stint as a teacher that year.
examples.text_zh: 那年他当过一段时间的教师。

examples.text_en: Do not stint on the food for the guests.
examples.text_zh: 招待客人时不要在食物上节省。
